mapper.select:
SELECT A.EPISODE AS LocalDateTimeEpisode, B.USER_ID AS userId, A.LOCATION AS location FROM MEETING_SCHEDULE A LEFT OUTER JOIN (SELECT * FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}) B ON A.EPISODE = B.EPISODE WHERE A.COMPLETE_FLAG = 'N'
AND A.EPISODE > DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 6 HOUR) ORDER BY A.EPISODE ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PARTICIPANT_USER(USER_ID, EPISODE, SEX, NICKNAME) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{episode}, (SELECT SEX FROM USER_TABLE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}), ( SELECT VALUE1 FROM ( SELECT VALUE1 FROM CRITERIA_DATA WHERE DIVISION = ( SELECT CASE WHEN SEX = '남성' THEN 'male_nickname' ELSE 'female_nickname' END FROM USER_TABLE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ) AND VALUE1 NOT IN ( SELECT NICKNAME FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE EPISODE = #{episode} ) ORDER BY RAND() LIMIT 1 ) AS AA ) )
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND EPISODE = #{episode}
mapper.select: SELECT pass_flag FROM user_manage WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND PASS_FLAG = 'Y'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_table WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND phone_number IS NULL

SELECT A.USER_ID AS PICKED_USER_ID, NICKNAME, B.PICK, B.PICK_TYPE, A.EPISODE AS localDateTimeEpisode FROM PARTICIPANT_USER A
LEFT OUTER JOIN
(SELECT * FROM MATCHING A WHERE A.USER_ID = #{userId}) B ON A.NICKNAME = B.PICK AND A.EPISODE = B.EPISODE
WHERE SEX <> ( SELECT SEX FROM USER_TABLE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} ) AND A.EPISODE = (SELECT AA.EPISODE FROM ( SELECT EPISODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER () AS ROWNUM FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
AND EPISODE BETWEEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL -5 HOUR) AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 5 HOUR) ORDER BY EPISODE DESC )AA WHERE AA.ROWNUM =1 )

SELECT AA.PICK AS nickName, CC.PHONE_NUMBER AS phoneNumber FROM ( SELECT USER_ID, PICK, PICKED_USER FROM MATCHING WHERE USER_ID =#{userId} AND EPISODE = (SELECT EPISODE FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID =#{userId} AND EPISODE BETWEEN DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 hour) AND NOW()) ) AA INNER JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID FROM MATCHING WHERE PICKED_USER =#{userId} AND EPISODE = (SELECT EPISODE FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE USER_ID =#{userId} AND EPISODE BETWEEN DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 100 hour) AND DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 10 hour))
) BB ON AA.PICKED_USER = BB.USER_ID INNER JOIN ( SELECT USER_ID, PHONE_NUMBER FROM USER_TABLE ) CC ON AA.PICKED_USER = CC.USER_ID
SELECT CHANCE FROM USER_MANAGE WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_MANAGE SET CHANCE = CHANCE -1 WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
UPDATE USER_MANAGE SET CHANCE = CHANCE +1 WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MATCHING(USER_ID, PICK, PICKED_USER, EPISODE, CREATETIME) VALUES(#{userId},#{nickName}, (SELECT USER_ID FROM PARTICIPANT_USER WHERE EPISODE = #{episode} AND NICKNAME = #{nickName}), #{episode}, SYSDATE())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM MATCHING WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND EPISODE = #{episode} AND PICK = #{nickName}
mapper.select: SELECT A.SEX AS sex, B.JOB_DIVISION AS jobDivision, A.EPISODE AS episode, YEAR(CURDATE()) - YEAR(B.BIRTHDAY) AS year FROM participant_user A INNER JOIN USER_TABLE B ON A.USER_ID = B.USER_ID WHERE EPISODE IN ( SELECT episode FROM participant_user WHERE 1=1 AND episode > NOW() ) ORDER BY A.CREATETIME ASC
